= SMW Property Definitions: Complete BITwiki Property Catalog =

== Executive Summary

This document catalogs all Semantic MediaWiki properties used in BITwiki. Each property includes its type, constraints, inverse properties, and usage examples.

'''Total Properties:''' 150+ across 12 categories  
'''Property Types:''' Text, Page, URL, Date, Number, Boolean, and specialized types  
'''External Alignment:''' RDF, SKOS, Dublin Core, Schema.org  

----
== 1. Core Properties

=== 1.1 Identity Properties

| Property | Type | Description | Example |
|----------|------|-------------|---------|
| `Has title` | Text | Primary display name | "BITwiki Constitution" |
| `Has description` | Text | Brief summary | "Foundational principles..." |
| `Has entity type` | Text | Classification | Concept, Project, Source |
| `Has identifier` | Text | Unique ID | "BIT-001" |
| `Has URI` | URL | Canonical URL | https://bitwiki.org/... |

'''SMW Definition:'''
```mediawiki
[[Has type::Text]]
[[Has title::Has title]]
[[Has description::Primary display name for entity]]
```

=== 1.2 Temporal Properties

| Property | Type | Description | Example |
|----------|------|-------------|---------|
| `Has creation date` | Date | When created | 2026-02-13 |
| `Has modification date` | Date | Last edited | 2026-02-13 |
| `Has event timestamp` | DateTime | Precise timestamp | 2026-02-13T10:30:00Z |
| `Has validity start` | Date | Valid from | 2026-01-01 |
| `Has validity end` | Date | Valid until | 2026-12-31 |

'''SMW Definition:'''
```mediawiki
[[Has type::Date]]
[[Has title::Has creation date]]
[[Has description::Date when entity was created]]
```

=== 1.3 Authorship Properties

| Property | Type | Description | Example |
|----------|------|-------------|---------|
| `Has author` | Page | Creator | User:Hyperion |
| `Has editor` | Page | Last editor | User:Hyperion |
| `Has contributor` | Page | Contributors | User:Coraline |
| `Was generated by` | Page | Generating process | Template:Document_Header |
| `Attributed to` | Page | Attribution | Hyperion |

'''SMW Definition:'''
```mediawiki
[[Has type::Page]]
[[Has title::Has author]]
[[Has description::Primary author or creator]]
```

----
== 2. Epistemic Properties

=== 2.1 Status Properties

| Property | Type | Description | Values |
|----------|------|-------------|--------|
| `Has epistemic status` | Text | Knowledge tier | Axiomatic, Established, Emerging, Hypothetical, Contested |
| `Has confidence` | Number | Confidence score | 0.0-1.0 |
| `Has confidence level` | Text | Qualitative | High, Medium, Low |
| `Has evidence strength` | Text | Evidence quality | Primary, Secondary, Tertiary |
| `Has verification status` | Text | Verification state | Verified, Unverified, Disputed |

'''SMW Definition:'''
```mediawiki
[[Has type::Number]]
[[Has title::Has confidence]]
[[Has description::Numerical confidence score 0.0-1.0]]
[[Has property constraint::Range: 0.0-1.0]]
```

=== 2.2 Evidence Properties

| Property | Type | Description | Example |
|----------|------|-------------|---------|
| `Has evidence count` | Number | Number of sources | 10 |
| `Has primary source count` | Number | Tier 1 sources | 5 |
| `Has citation count` | Number | Times cited | 25 |
| `Has falsification conditions` | Text | Testable conditions | "If X observed, claim false" |
| `Has prediction accuracy` | Number | Track record | 0.85 |

'''SMW Definition:'''
```mediawiki
[[Has type::Number]]
[[Has title::Has evidence count]]
[[Has description::Total number of evidence sources]]
```

=== 2.3 Provenance Properties

| Property | Type | Description | Example |
|----------|------|-------------|---------|
| `Was derived from` | Page | Parent entity | BITwiki_Charter |
| `Has source` | Page | Evidence source | Source:Smith_2024 |
| `Has DOI` | Text | Digital identifier | 10.1000/xyz |
| `Has URL` | URL | Web reference | https://... |
| `Has provenance type` | Text | Source type | Verified, Unverified |

'''SMW Definition:'''
```mediawiki
[[Has type::Page]]
[[Has title::Was derived from]]
[[Has description::Parent or source entity]]
[[Has inverse property::Is derivation of]]
```

----

=== 3.1 Classification Properties

| Property | Type | Description | Example |
|----------|------|-------------|---------|
| `Has domain` | Text | Subject area | Systems science |
| `Has subdomain` | Text | Specific field | Cybernetics |
| `Has parent concept` | Page | Broader concept | Knowledge |
| `Has child concept` | Page | Narrower concept | BITwiki |
| `Has related entity` | Page | Connected entity | SMW |

'''SMW Definition:'''
```mediawiki

[[Has title::Has parent concept]]
[[Has description::Broader or parent concept]]
[[Has inverse property::Has child concept]]
```

=== 3.2 Relationship Properties

| Property | Type | Description | Example |
|----------|------|-------------|---------|
| `Has relationship type` | Text | Nature of relation | Implements, Contradicts |
| `Has dependency` | Page | Required entity | SMW |

| `Has prerequisite` | Page | Required knowledge | Ontology |

[[Has title::Has relationship type]]
[[Has description::Type of relationship between entities]]

[[Has allowed value::Depends on]]
```

----

```

| `Has epistemic quality score` | Number | Epistemic dimension | 0.88 |
| `Has structural quality score` | Number | Structure dimension | 0.90 |
| `Has validation date` | Date | Last validated | 2026-02-13 |
| `Has validator` | Page | Who validated | User:Hyperion |

'''SMW Definition:'''
```mediawiki
[[Has type::Number]]
[[Has title::Has overall quality score]]
[[Has description::Aggregate quality score 0.0-1.0]]
```

----
== 5. External Alignment Properties

=== 5.1 Wikipedia Alignment

|----------|------|-------------|---------|
| `Has Wikipedia article` | Page | Wikipedia page | Systems_science |
| `Has Wikipedia category` | Text | WP category | Category:Systems_science |
| `Has Wikipedia quality` | Text | WP quality class | FA, GA, B |

'''SMW Definition:'''
```mediawiki
[[Has type::Page]]
[[Has title::Has Wikipedia article]]
[[Has description::Corresponding Wikipedia article]]
```

=== 5.2 Wikidata Alignment

| Property | Type | Description | Example |
|----------|------|-------------|---------|
| `Has Wikidata item` | Text | Q-identifier | Q12345 |
| `Has Wikidata label` | Text | WD label | Systems science |
| `Has Wikidata property` | Text | WD property | P31 |

'''SMW Definition:'''
```mediawiki
[[Has type::Text]]
[[Has title::Has Wikidata item]]
[[Has description::Wikidata Q-identifier]]
```

=== 5.3 Schema.org Alignment

| Property | Type | Description | Example |
|----------|------|-------------|---------|
| `Has Schema.org type` | Text | Schema type | Project |
| `Has Schema.org property` | Text | Schema property | name |

'''SMW Definition:'''
```mediawiki
[[Has type::Text]]
[[Has title::Has Schema.org type]]
[[Has description::Corresponding Schema.org type]]
```

----
== 6. Specialized Properties

=== 6.1 Event Properties

| Property | Type | Description | Example |
|----------|------|-------------|---------|
| `Has event type` | Text | Type of event | Creation, Modification |
| `Was observed at` | DateTime | Observation time | 2026-02-13T10:30:00Z |
| `Was observed by` | Page | Observer | User:Hyperion |
| `Has duration` | Number | Event duration | 3600 |

'''SMW Definition:'''
```mediawiki
[[Has type::Text]]
[[Has title::Has event type]]
[[Has description::Type of event]]
[[Has allowed value::Creation]]
[[Has allowed value::Modification]]
[[Has allowed value::Deletion]]
[[Has allowed value::Validation]]
```

=== 6.2 Governance Properties

| Property | Type | Description | Example |
|----------|------|-------------|---------|
| `Has steward` | Page | Assigned steward | User:Hyperion |
| `Has arbitration date` | Date | Arbitration scheduled | 2026-03-01 |
| `Has arbitration status` | Text | Status | Pending, Resolved |
| `Has policy reference` | Page | Governing policy | BITwiki_Policy |

'''SMW Definition:'''
```mediawiki
[[Has type::Page]]
[[Has title::Has steward]]
[[Has description::Assigned steward for entity]]
```

=== 6.3 Technical Properties

| Property | Type | Description | Example |
|----------|------|-------------|---------|
| `Has file format` | Text | Format | markdown, wiki |
| `Has file size` | Number | Size in bytes | 10240 |
| `Has word count` | Number | Word count | 1500 |
| `Has line count` | Number | Line count | 200 |

'''SMW Definition:'''
```mediawiki
[[Has type::Number]]
[[Has title::Has word count]]
[[Has description::Number of words in document]]
```

----
== 7. Property Constraints

=== 7.1 Range Constraints

| Property | Constraint | Enforcement |
|----------|------------|-------------|
| `Has confidence` | 0.0-1.0 | SMW validation |
| `Has quality score` | 0.0-1.0 | SMW validation |
| `Has evidence count` | >= 0 | SMW validation |
| `Has word count` | >= 0 | SMW validation |

'''SMW Implementation:'''
```mediawiki
[[Has property constraint::Range: 0.0-1.0]]
[[Has property constraint::Minimum: 0]]
```

=== 7.2 Allowed Values

| Property | Allowed Values |
|----------|----------------|
| `Has epistemic status` | Axiomatic, Established, Emerging, Hypothetical, Contested |
| `Has workflow state` | Alpha, Beta, Active, Deprecated, Archived |
| `Has relationship type` | Implements, Contradicts, Extends, Depends on |
| `Has event type` | Creation, Modification, Deletion, Validation |

'''SMW Implementation:'''
```mediawiki
[[Has allowed value::Axiomatic]]
[[Has allowed value::Established]]
[[Has allowed value::Emerging]]
[[Has allowed value::Hypothetical]]
[[Has allowed value::Contested]]
```

=== 7.3 Cardinality Constraints

| Property | Cardinality | Notes |
|----------|-------------|-------|
| `Has title` | 1 | Single title per entity |
| `Has author` | 1..'' | At least one author |
| `Has related entity` | 0..'' | Optional, multiple allowed |
| `Has domain` | 1..* | At least one domain |

----
== 8. Inverse Properties

| Property | Inverse | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `Has parent concept` | `Has child concept` | Hierarchical |
| `Has related entity` | `Is related to` | Symmetric |
| `Was derived from` | `Is derivation of` | Provenance |
| `Has prerequisite` | `Is prerequisite for` | Dependency |
| `Has implementation` | `Implements` | Realization |

'''SMW Definition:'''
```mediawiki
[[Has type::Page]]
[[Has title::Has parent concept]]
[[Has inverse property::Has child concept]]
```

----
== 9. External Vocabulary Import

=== 9.1 RDF Alignment

| BITwiki Property | RDF Property | Namespace |
|------------------|--------------|-----------|
| `Has title` | `dc:title` | http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/ |
| `Has author` | `dc:creator` | http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/ |
| `Has creation date` | `dc:date` | http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/ |
| `Has related entity` | `skos:related` | http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core# |
| `Has parent concept` | `skos:broader` | http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core# |

'''SMW Import:'''
```mediawiki
[[Imported from::dc:title]]
[[Corresponds to::http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/title]]
```

=== 9.2 Schema.org Alignment

| BITwiki Property | Schema.org Property |
|------------------|---------------------|
| `Has title` | `schema:name` |
| `Has description` | `schema:description` |
| `Has author` | `schema:author` |
| `Has creation date` | `schema:dateCreated` |

----
== 10. Property Usage Statistics

'''Most Used Properties:'''
# `Has title` - All pages
# `Has entity type` - All typed pages
# `Has epistemic status` - All content pages
# `Has confidence` - All content pages
# `Has author` - All authored pages
# `Has creation date` - All pages
# `Has domain` - Domain-specific pages
# `Has related entity` - Linked pages

'''Query for Property Usage:'''
```mediawiki
{{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::+]]
|?Has epistemic status
|format=count
}}
```

----
== 11. Property Creation Guidelines

=== 11.1 Naming Conventions
* Use verb-phrase format: "Has X", "Was X", "Is X"
* Use lowercase with underscores: `has_property_name`
* Be specific: `Has confidence` not `Has value`
* Avoid abbreviations: `Has creation date` not `Has date`

=== 11.2 Type Selection

| Data | SMW Type | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| Free text | Text | Default |
| Page reference | Page | Creates link |
| Date only | Date | No time |
| Date + time | DateTime | Full timestamp |
| Number | Number | Decimal allowed |
| Integer | Integer | Whole numbers |
| True/false | Boolean | Binary |
| URL | URL | Validates format |
| Email | Email | Validates format |

=== 11.3 Documentation Requirements

Every property page must include:
* `[[Has type::...]]` declaration
* `[[Has description::...]]` explanation
* `[[Has domain::...]]` if applicable
* Constraints (range, allowed values)
* Inverse property if applicable
* External alignment if applicable

----
== Conclusion

This property catalog enables consistent semantic markup across BITwiki. By following these definitions, all content becomes machine-queryable and interoperable with external knowledge systems.

'''Key Principles:'''
* Use verb-phrase property names
* Declare types explicitly
* Document constraints
* Align with external vocabularies
* Maintain inverse relationships

'''Next Steps:'''
# Create Property: namespace pages for all properties
# Import external vocabularies
# Validate property usage
# Monitor property statistics
# Extend as needed
